headline: Finland Rules Out Future Gas Deals with Russia Amid Ukraine Conflict
summary: Finland's Prime Minister stated that the country will not enter into any new natural gas deals with Russia while the war in Ukraine continues.
why: European energy independence and Russian gas embargoes affect regional utility pricing and European macroeconomic stability.

impacts.name: European Energy
impacts.why: Permanent decoupling from Russian natural gas forces European utilities to secure alternative, potentially costlier supplies.
